title: GOG
description: Combined GOG feed: the GOG Blog, the Pressroom, and the storefront news column in Polish and English.

items.title: Release:REANIMAL - The Prisoner
items.content_text: Tarsier Studios are back with a new chapter in the dread-filled horror adventure game REANIMAL – REANIMAL - The Prisoner is now available on GOG! This DLC features two brand new characters, The Soldier and the Prisoner, who must survive the war-ravaged streets of a once-familiar place, stumbling blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever. Explore previously unseen areas of the world of REANIMAL, on foot and otherwise, and discover that while war can be hell, some experiences

items.title: Release:Alphadia III
items.content_text: Alphadia III is a turn-based jRPG – and it's now available on GOG! Before Alphadia I, the world was torn by the Energi War – fueled by humanity's lust for life energy. In the midst of it, an energi clone named Alfonso begins to question everything. With nothing but his doubts and determination, he sets off on a journey to uncover meaning in a world consumed by power. What truth awaits at the end of his path? Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Montabi
items.content_text: Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder – in Montabi , now available on GOG! Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat! Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:The Skin Stapler
items.content_text: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City – and it’s now available on GOG, alongside its Soundtrack ! Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
items.content_text: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine – and it’s now available on GOG! Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:BONEREADER
items.content_text: Roll the dice for a shot at rebirth in this otherworldly card game adventure – BONEREADER is now available on GOG, alongside its Artbook ! Build your deck, harness mystical dice, and battle spirits in a deadly game of chance through a psychedelic purgatory. Will you escape – or be damned for eternity? Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Jazz Jackrabbit 2 Plus
items.content_text: Jazz Jackrabbit 2 Plus mods Jazz Jackrabbit 2 to add countless features and bug fixes – from the game-crashing to the incredibly obscure – to Single Player, Multiplayer, and level editing. It’s now available on GOG as a One-click Mod ! Rather than impose our gameplay vision on you or break backwards compatibility, this mod adds tools to every part of the game so you can create new Jazzy experiences for yourself. For example, level designers can use death pits, new textured backgrounds, 32-bit gr

items.title: Release:Is This Seat Taken?
items.content_text: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people – and it’s now available on GOG! Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Fantasy Network
items.content_text: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power – in Fantasy Network , now available on GOG! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:The Artisan of Glimmith
items.content_text: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds – and it’s now available on GOG! Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises. Now on GOG!

items.title: Coming soon:Ward Off Evil
items.content_text: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world – and it’s coming soon on GOG! Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle. Wishlist it now!

items.title: Release:Total Chaos Mod
items.content_text: Total Chaos Mod is a total conversion mod for Doom 2 that runs on the GZDoom source port – now available on as GOG One-click Mod ! The mod is a survival horror set on a remote island known as Fort Oasis. The island was once run by a community of coal miners which one day suddenly disappeared, leaving behind the abandoned concrete jungle to waste away. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:KIBORG with extras
items.content_text: KIBORG is a brutal rogue-lite beat’em up where you enhance your body with new cybernetic implants each run – and it’s now available on GOG! You’ve been sent to the worst prison in the galaxy for crimes you didn’t commit. Death won’t provide an escape, but a violent reality show may offer a way out. You can also get: KIBORG: Descent KIBORG Deluxe Edition KIBORG Soundtrack KIBORG - Art Book Now on GOG!

items.title: Coming soon:Timespinner 2: Unwoven Dream
items.content_text: Travel to the Tower in the Sea to avert the apocalypse, in this exploration action-platformer – Timespinner 2: Unwoven Dream is coming soon on GOG! Join Auria, a retired war hero, as she adventures through a beautiful and dangerous world to save her family and the fabric of reality itself! Wishlist it now!

items.title: GOG takes the story of Polish video games to the walls of the Warsaw Barbican
items.content_text: • Open-air exhibition on the history of Polish game development • July 31st, 2026 – An open-air exhibition on the history of Polish game development is now up on the walls of the Barbican in Warsaw’s Old Town. We’re incredibly proud to be the patron of the exhibition, prepared together with the Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Indie Games Poland Foundation. Eighteen boards, each in Polish and English, run from the games written on 8-bit machines in the 1980s to productions that sell in

items.title: Out of Early Access:Astro Burn
items.content_text: Get ready, because Astro Burn is now out of early access on GOG! A fast-paced sci-fi cute-em-up filled with colourful bullet-hell chaos and giant adorable animals in huge mechs. Play as Astro a space cat, as you blast, dodge, upgrade, trigger Catnip Mode, and take down screen-filling cute critters overload in retro arcade style. You can also get the Astro Burn Soundtrack . Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Fallout - New California
items.content_text: Embark on the ultimate unofficial prequel to Fallout: New Vegas – Fallout - New California is now available as GOG One-click Mod! One of the biggest story mods ever made, this standalone campaign features an entirely new map with brand-new areas, starting inside Vault 18 and spanning the New California wasteland. Fight through an epic war between the NCR, Enclave, Raiders, and Super Mutants, complete with studio-quality voice acting, dynamic radio, and 8 unique companions. Now on GOG!

items.title: Coming soon:Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
items.content_text: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is the sequel to the multi-million selling classic, Croc Legend of the Gobbos – and it’s coming soon on GOG! The night before Croc's next adventure begins, Professor Gobbo witnesses the Dantinis resurrecting Baron Dante, and is taken prisoner for seeing too much. Back on the beach at Gobbo Valley, Croc is playing when he spots a bottle washed up in the sand. Inside is a message revealing that his birth parents are searching for him. He sets off for the mainland to fi

items.content_text: • Video Games From Poland • July 29, 2026 – We’re happy to announce our involvement in the inaugural Video Games From Poland that will take place this October, as a national celebration of Polish video games. The event is organized and coordinated by the Creative Industries Institute, a state cultural institution supervised by the Polish Ministry of Culture and National Heritage. It’s the first time anywhere in the world that a country celebrates its own games industry at state level! During the

items.title: Release:Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong
items.content_text: Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong is another beloved installment fof the series – and it's now available on GOG! Based on the cult role-playing game and developed by specialists in the genre, Vampire: The Masquerade – Swansong is a narrative RPG in which your every choice determines the fate of the three main characters and of the Boston Camarilla. What if vampires were real? What if these bloodthirsty predators lived hidden among us in complex societies and had been hatching conspiracies for t

items.title: Coming soon:Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance
items.content_text: Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance is an action shoot-em-up game – and it's coming soon on GOG! Storm City is drowning in crime and corruption. The streets belong to violent gangs, ruthless corporations and anyone with enough firepower to take what they want. The old ways failed. So justice answered with a roar. You are the Sentinel. Storm City’s first cybernetic law enforcer, built to restore order by any means necessary. Wishlist it now!

items.title: Release:Ova Magica
items.content_text: Ova Magica is a simulation game – and it's now available on GOG! Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time – raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends.   Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience. Now on GOG!

For nearly three decades, the franchise has taken players on unforgettable journeys across the stars, combining fantasy and science fiction into adventures that have earned a devoted following around the world. items.title: Release:Aisle Survive
items.content_text: Aisle Survive is a strategy action roguelike game – and it's now available in early access on GOG! Jade operates the last human-run store in Mech City. Her employees must work harder and faster than any robot in existence - or suffer the consequences.   Glen, however, has reached his limit. He's done with retail; he's ready to quit. But there's just one problem: If he doesn't work his notice, Jade will ruin him. You can also get Aisle Survive Soundtrack and Aisle Survive - "Spare the Change" Sup

items.title: Release:Tower of Kalemonvo
items.content_text: Tower of Kalemonvo is an RPG adventure fantasy – and it's now available on GOG! Reinforcements are not coming. Resupply is impossible. Your ascent begins. Tower of Kalemonvo is a challenging dark fantasy Action RPG - following the slower pace and high tension seen in genre-defining classics like Diablo 1 and Throne of Darkness. Defeat wicked foes, grow stronger, gather whatever loot you can find, and tread lightly - as every encounter could be your last! Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Terra Invicta - Dark Skies
items.content_text: Explore two new starting scenarios in Terra Invicta - Dark Skies and face the existential threat of an alien invasion with new challenges and opportunities – now available on GOG! Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire over a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a longer, slower fight on Earth. The premise changes, but the threat doesn’t – aliens are coming, and it's time to fight back. You can also get the Terra Invicta - Supporter Pack . Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Graphite
items.content_text: Graphite is a strategy RPG rougelike – and it's now available on GOG! Death is inevitable. But maybe – just maybe – there’s time to make things right. Graphite is a stylized roguelike RPG where the fantasy and wonder of a kid’s imagination come to life across the pages of his own pen-and-paper campaign.   Armed with nothing but scribbled heroes, borrowed school notebooks, household junk, and a head full of what-ifs, he builds a world to navigate grief, self-confidence, and growing up. Now on GOG

items.title: Release:Crimson Oath
items.content_text: Prepare to suffer in Crimson Oath – now available on GOG! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Grim Dawn - Fangs of Asterkarn
items.content_text: If you enjoyed Grim Dawn , we have some great news for you – Grim Dawn - Fangs of Asterkarn is now available on GOG! Trek across the glorious snowy peaks of Asterkarn, delve into frozen caverns, and explore ancient forest valleys and breathtaking hot springs as you seek to purge the corruption tainting this idyllic landscape. Parley with the Kurn tribes and aid them in rekindling old alliances as you contend with the darker side of their bloody history. Uncover hundreds of new items and create w

items.title: Release:Above the Snow
items.content_text: Join the shelter crew and create the best Alpine resort in this cozy narrative tycoon – Above the Snow is now available on GOG, alongside The Alpine Edition ! Enjoy rich character stories, attract and rescue alpinists, manage your resort, and forge new trails. Grab your map, pour a warm cup of tea, and brace for the harshest winter of the 1960s. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:Possible One: Lunar Industries
items.content_text: Stake your claim in the first realistic lunar colony management game – Possible One: Lunar Industries is now available on GOG! Use proven, real-world technologies to plan and grow your colony, mine resources, ship them to Earth, and keep the board of directors happy in this science-based colony sim. Now on GOG!

items.title: Release:The Ember Guardian with extras
items.content_text: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world – The Ember Guardian is now available on GOG! Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons. You can also get: The Ember Guardian - Husky Skin Supporter Pack The Ember Guardian Soundtrack The Ember Guardian: Supporter Bundle Now on GOG!
